UnQLite is a self-contained, serverless, transactional database engine for C and C++ applications. It runs in-process, stores data in a single portable file, and ships as a compact embed-friendly codebase with no external dependencies. Two operational layers are provided: a raw key/value store for binary-safe records and a document store powered by the Jx9 embedded scripting language.

- Model S/X up to model year 2021 with MCU2 are now also supported by the official Fleet API.

- Please update docker-compose.yml: [LINK](https://github.com/bassmaster187/TeslaLogger/blob/master/docker_setup.md#docker-update--upgrade)
- Watchtower cleanup: remove old images after update
- Grafana doesn't forget settings of starred dashboards anymore (and other settings as well). Grafana.db is now persistend if you update docker-compose.yml

- Use PHP 8.5.12 to fix security issues. (PHP2SHELL vulnerability)
- Use Debian Trixie

- BF: MQTT commands (teslalogger/command/...) were ignored after a reconnect to the MQTT broker, because the subscription was not restored (reconnect uses cleanSession=true)
- MQTT: the command response is now published to teslalogger/command///result, so home-automation setups can verify the command (e.q. vehicle unavailable)
- Grafana 13.2.4 (Security Update)

- AI clients like Claude Desktop can connect to TeslaLogger's MCP server. This opens up a wide range of new possibilities. More info: [LINK](https://teslalogger.de/docs/extras/mcp-server)
- Support Lucid Gravity
- Docker image contains now OVMS (Open Vehicle Monitoring System) client. If you have a car supported by OVMS, you can start logging it with TeslaLogger. More info: [LINK](https://github.com/bassmaster187/OVMSLogger#ovmslogger-beta)
- Modernize code for .NET 8

- Settings: Bar / PSI
- Automatic switch to .NET 8 on Raspberry Pi installations

- online update of geofence.csv
- Nominal Full / SOH Pack Capacity in Dashboard Battery Degradation (Lucid Air)
- CAC min / max in Dashboard Battery Degradation (ScanMyTesla)
- Charging Curves in Dashboard Charging Statistics
- Whole documentation now online instead of a PDF. You're welcome to contribute: [LINK](https://teslalogger.de/docs)
- Link to description of Vehicle Alerts in Dashboard Vehicle Alerts
- Support for Cybertruck / Cyberbeast

- faster logging (positions every 10 seconds)
- Komoot integration (admin panel / extras / Komoot Settings)
- New Wallbox: Openwb 2
- Local Fleet Telemetry support with ZMQ

- 最低依赖 octop-memory 1.0.5。定时裁剪跳过 PostgreSQL 共享表；宿主确认线程归属并暂停该线程后，可用离线接口按线程裁剪。SQLite 会把保留边界仍需要的旧消息并入边界 checkpoint，再删掉更早的父链。
* fix: keep shared PostgreSQL checkpoints out of scheduled pruning by @Bosheng0422 in https://github.com/TencentCloud/octop-harness/pull/262

### 新增

- 每个 agent 可单独配置自动压缩的触发、保留和截断，也可关闭自动触发。`/compact` 和上下文溢出仍可摘要。
- 配置 `managed_runner` 后，该 agent 把每一轮转发给指定 ACP runner，不再进入模型循环。

### 修复

- OpenAI 兼容流式调用只保留最后一个 chunk 的 usage，避免累计 usage 被重复累加。



## What's Changed
* chore: sync main into develop after 1.0.9 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/TencentCloud/oct
- SQLite checkpoint 裁剪默认只在首次清理前尝试备份，备份保留 7 天。空间不足或备份失败时继续裁剪，标记会阻止重复尝试。`always` 要求每次备份成功后才裁剪，`off` 关闭备份。
* fix(memory): defer database release until background workers finish by @Bosheng0422 in https://github.com/TencentCloud/octop-harness/pull/113

- OpenSandbox 可以创建、删除和移动工作区路径。专家启动、技能卸载和工作区重命名不再因为沙箱没有这些操作而失败。
* fix: let OpenSandbox create, delete, and move paths by @jubaoliang in https://github.com/TencentCloud/octop-harness/pull/217

### 新增

- 回复和可见思考固定使用配置的语言，并排在工作区记忆之后。

### 修复

- 经 `call_deferred_tool` 调用的可用核心工具会直接执行；已禁用的工具仍然不可用。
- 记忆模型因 temperature 被拒绝时，省略 temperature 再试一次（TencentCloud/Octop#835）。
- 压缩摘要只发送更短的历史；仍然放不下时才用占位内容。
- 只有文件名的 glob 必须带路径。
- LLM HTTP 调用带有显式超时，上游挂起不会

### 新增

- 可选网页搜索：you.com、腾讯元宝 SearchPro、DeepSeek Search。
- 新增 `ManagedMCPClient`，支持持久 MCP 会话。
- 刷新腾讯云 HAI 预设，DeepSeek Flash 标为多模态。

### 修复

- MCP 工具失败改为工具错误结果，本轮继续，并保留参数 schema。
- HITL 恢复时保留请求身份、工具选择和语言。
- 决策筛选保留发文件、浏览和截图工具。
- 提前结束 agent 流时关闭内层生成器，避免 ContextVar 报错。
